lockState.searchScope: the full recursive git tree at the pinned revision (72 blobs)
lockState.honestAssessment: This is the good case. The closure is pinned by a committed lockfile, so it is reproducible from the repository alone as long as the registry still serves the pinned versions. Contrast with corpus members that ship no lockfile at all.

lockContents.integrityCaveat: 710 of 710 entries carry an integrity hash, but the algorithm set mixes legacy sha1 with sha512. sha1 entries are era artifacts of packages published before npm moved to sha512; they are recorded as found, not upgraded or replaced.
lockContents.note: No entry resolves to a git host, a fork tarball, or a private registry. The whole closure comes from one public registry host.

declaredDirectDependencies.rangeStyle: mostly caret ranges, with seven exact pins (date-fns, react-select, slugify, eslint, eslint-config-next, jest, jest-resolve). The caret ranges are harmless in practice because the committed lockfile decides.
observations: @emotion/core ^11.0.0 is declared but @emotion/core was deprecated at v10; v11 is a stub that re-exports @emotion/react. Recorded as found.

lodash is imported by components/Carbon.tsx but is not a declared direct dependency. It resolves transitively, and only @types/lodash is declared. The typecheck passes today because a transitive lodash is hoisted into the root of node_modules; that is a hoisting accident, not a declared contract.

moment ^2.29.1 is a devDependency used by graveyard.test.ts (the Jest data test) and by the bin/kill maintainer script. No application source file imports it; the application uses date-fns for its date arithmetic.
enquirer is declared as a runtime dependency but is used only by the bin/kill maintainer script, not by the application.

installedInBaselineCell.generatedBy: yarn 1.22.19 on Node 16.20.2 during this unit's baseline install, honouring --frozen-lockfile
installedInBaselineCell.webpackNote: webpack does not appear as a top-level node_modules entry because Next.js 12 vendors its own webpack 5 inside the next package. The bundler ceiling for this fixture is therefore set by Next itself, not by a separately resolvable dependency.
installedInBaselineCell.frozenLockfileMeaning: yarn did not need to modify the lockfile to satisfy the manifest, so the manifest and the lockfile at the pin are mutually consistent.

nonclaims: This record describes what the committed lockfile pins and what one install placed. It is not a licence review of the closure and not a vulnerability assessment.

That the closure resolved today does not establish that it will resolve in future, nor that any package still served is byte-identical to what was published in 2022; only the integrity hashes in the lockfile speak to that, and they were not independently re-verified here.
